TASK-2053 S5 assignment stopped for the requested scope clarification. Posted the full question on TASK-2053.

S5 scope clarification requested before implementation (2026-10-23 21:52 MST assignment).

The new assignment requests TASK-2053 S5 host clone pool plus folded TASK-2300 and TASK-1-471 (current display ID TASK-1840), building on origin/main after S4b/S4c. It explicitly directs me to stop, comment here and mail the advisor if the S5 comments are ambiguous or implementation exceeds the signed sketch.

The canonical scope conflicts with a pool implementation:
- Advisor 2026-10-22 14:16: pack loose objects first; if cold p95 <=20 s, S5 is only packing plus a doctor check; otherwise post SKETCH S5 before building a pool.
- Packing outcome comment 01a1661b-de3e-78b3-bd33-6967561c0ecd reports cold p95 3.3 s and explicitly says “No host clone pool and no SKETCH.”
- docs/plans/2026-10-16-bug-2169-contained-clone.md lines 695-702 records packing plus the loose-object doctor check (#2847), with no pool built.
- TASK-2053 is currently canonically Completed. Latest 18:28/18:57 rulings fold TASK-2300 and TASK-1-471 into S5, but do not explicitly reverse the no-pool ruling.

Question: should this assignment (A, recommended) retain the no-pool ruling and implement only the folded default-origin-unreachable worktree fallback with a note, documentation and tests, treating packing/doctor as already delivered; or (B) reopen the host clone pool architecture, with a new explicit scope/sketch approval before implementation? Please also confirm whether TASK-2053 should reopen for the folded work and which trailer applies given its current Completed state.

Stopped before fetch, worktree/branch creation, claim, code edits, tests, commits, pushes or PR actions. No automatic reopen or claim attempted. Awaiting scope ruling; no pool design inferred.
subject: TASK-2053 S5 scope clarification: pool conflicts with no-pool ruling
